build_calibrate_plausibility_regions: calibrate a threshold for plausibility regions using conformity scores and alpha confidence level
create_expected_conformity_score: compute expected conformity scores by weighting conformity scores with plausibilities across classes
test_check_plausibility_regions: test coverage of plausibility regions against a calibrated threshold for each example
run_predict_plausibility_regions: predict plausibility regions on a grid of plausibility samples with corresponding coverages
summarize_reduce_plausibilities_to_topk: summarize plausibility regions into top-k confidence sets by aggregating covered samples
